assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and dizziness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
Mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies
The service is medically necessary to evaluate symptoms in the context of the patient's documented paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and prior transient ischemic attack
